rule.name: ConcurrentMapCheckThenAct
rule.message: This concurrent map is checked and then used again for the same key (containsKey or get(key) == null, then put, get or remove), but another thread can change the entry between the two calls: two threads both see it absent and both create the value, or the get returns null after containsKey said true. A ConcurrentMap makes each call atomic, not the pair. Use one atomic call: map.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> create(k)), map.putIfAbsent(key, value), map.getOrDefault(key, fallback), map.computeIfPresent or merge, or read once into a local (Value v = map.get(key); if (v == null) ...). An exception fits a map that only one thread changes, or a pair that is already locked.
